[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1702. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1073|John Glasgow]] and [[Scott-40313|Margaret Scott]].
== Research Notes ==

Recorded minister father and child; the minister’s own uncertain ancestry is outside this probability.
